provenance: Read off devnet at finalized slot 492,946,108, from cohort-15's first Direct market -- the market the public cut features. These bytes are that account, whole and unmodified. They exist so a gate can be proven RED against the one shape that has twice reached production: a Core Market whose owning cohort has been closed, or a public cut whose checked-release table is about a release set the featured market does not select. Neither refusal can be exercised against a synthetic record, because forging a 368-byte DCLTCOR3 by hand means forging exactly the invariants the decoder is there to check.
